mainEntity.name: What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for home service businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) focuses on making your home service business's information readily available and understandable for artificial intelligence-powered search engines and voice assistants. Unlike traditional SEO, which optimizes for keywords and search rankings, AEO aims to directly answer user queries in rich snippets, featured snippets, and voice search results. This involves structuring your content, such as service descriptions and FAQs, to directly address common questions. For home service businesses, this means ensuring details like 'plumber near me,' service hours, and specific repair options are easily extracted and presented to potential customers who use spoken queries or modern search interfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) helps home service businesses appear in direct answers for AI search engines and voice assistants by structuring content to answer common customer queries directly.
